The agent explained two residential pricing options: the Quick Fix program at $450 for 1 month with a $150 upfront setup fee (refundable if no moles are caught), and the Total Mole Control plan at $100 per month with a 12-month commitment, unlimited visits, and no setup fee. The call appears to be informational, with the customer gathering pricing details to make a decision about service.

name: SILKE,LETIZIA
summary: Liz from Mercer Island, Washington called Gotmolds to address a mole infestation in her backyard, characterized by visible dirt piles and a possible mole in her crawl space. Spencer presented two service options: a one-month quick fix service for $450 with a $150 deposit, or a Total Mold Control program at $100 per month with a one-year commitment that includes unlimited visits and perimeter trapping. Liz confirmed she has a dog on the property and was assured that all traps would be covered and staked safely with no chemicals or poisons used. An appointment was scheduled for Thursday afternoon (between 10:30 AM and 2:00 PM) at her address of 8290 Southeast 82nd Street, and Spencer will send her a quote to approve before the visit.

name: DAVID JOHAL
summary: Customer called to follow up on a mole treatment service request for their property, which is over 5 acres. The agent (Mo) confirmed that the owner Spencer had been notified via text message and system notification about the customer's inquiry. Mo committed to reaching out to Spencer again to check his availability for a callback to the customer.

name: WIRELESS CALLER
summary: Customer called to inquire about mole removal services for their residential yard. Agent Mo explained two pricing options: a $450 one-time quick fix service or a $100/month total mole control program with weekly visits and a 12-month commitment. The customer declined both options, citing concerns about cost and the length of the commitment, and ended the call without scheduling service.

name: LARENA WALSHE
summary: Lorena Walsh called to inquire about her mole control service, which she had canceled a few days prior after not seeing traps placed for several weeks. Agent Mo explained that traps are set both visibly and beneath the surface around the property perimeter, and offered her options to either restart service with a monthly plan (TMCP) or a quick fix solution. The agent agreed to contact his team to determine if Lorena could revoke her cancellation and continue with month-to-month service, or alternatively start fresh with a new service code, and committed to calling her back with an answer.

name: DAVID JOHAL
summary: A new customer called Got Moles outside of business hours to inquire about the company's services. The agent collected the caller's information for follow-up and offered to answer questions about what the business does. No specific issues, appointments, or transactions were discussed during this initial contact.
